name: foto-owl
description: Headless media SDK ecosystem: framework-agnostic core, platform wrappers, pure-UI headless components, and a demo app backed by the Pexels API.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fotoowl/media-core && npm run build --workspace @fotoowl/media-react && npm run build --workspace @fotoowl/media-ui-react
scripts.docs:site: typedoc packages/media-core/src/index.ts --tsconfig packages/media-core/tsconfig.json --name "media-core SDK" --out packages/app/dist/docs/sdk && typedoc packages/media-ui-react/src/index.ts --tsconfig packages/media-ui-react/tsconfig.json --name "media-ui-react components" --out packages/app/dist/docs/components
